_comment: The store listing. Translatable text that is NOT app UI, so it lives in
meta rather than locales: nothing here ships inside a bundle.
The character limits are Apple's, and they are hard. A name over 30
characters is rejected at submission, not merely clipped. German runs long,
so these two are the hardest short-form writing in the whole job.
Google Play carries the same description, so it is written once.
There is no Finnish store listing: the Finnish storefront serves the English
text. So these two have no Finnish reference, and `fi` is empty rather than
invented. Checked against Apple's lookup API on 2026-09-01.

fields.note: Der Name unter dem Icon, im Store und auf dem Homescreen. Apple lehnt mehr als 30 Zeichen ab. 'Lexie' bleibt.
Steht direkt unter dem Namen im Store. Sagt in einer Zeile, was die App tut. Ebenfalls hart auf 30 Zeichen begrenzt.
